interface.name: zwlr_layer_shell_v1

description.summary: create surfaces that are layers of the desktop

interface.description: Clients can use this interface to assign the surface_layer role to wl_surfaces. Such surfaces are assigned to any of several layers rendered by the compositor.

entry.name: already_constructed
entry.summary: wl_surface has already been constructed into a layer_surface

request.name: get_layer_surface

description.summary: create a layer surface from a surface

request.description: Create a layer surface for a given surface. This assigns the role of layer_surface to the surface.

request.name: destroy
request.description: This request indicates that the client will not use the layer_shell object any more. Objects created through this instance are not affected.

interface.name: zwlr_layer_surface_v1
interface.description: An interface that may be implemented by a wl_surface, for surfaces that are designed to be rendered as a layer of a desktop.

request.name: set_size

description.summary: sets the size of the surface

request.description: Sets the size of the surface in surface-local coordinates.

request.name: set_anchor

description.summary: configures the anchor points of the surface

request.description: Requests that the compositor anchor the surface to the specified edges and corners.

request.name: set_exclusive_zone
request.description: Requests that the compositor avoids occluding an area of the desktop.

request.name: set_margin

description.summary: sets a margin from the anchor point

request.description: Requests that the surface be placed some distance away from the anchor point on the output.

request.name: set_keyboard_interactivity
request.description: Set how the layer surface handles keyboard focus.

request.name: get_popup

description.summary: assign this layer_surface as parent of an xdg_popup

request.description: This assigns an xdg_popup's parent to this layer_surface.

request.name: ack_configure
request.description: When a configure event is received, if a client draws a frame that a client wants to submit, standard Wayland state ack protocol applies.

request.name: destroy
request.description: This request destroys the layer surface.

event.name: configure
event.description: The configure event asks the client to resize or otherwise change the state of the layer surface.

event.name: closed
event.description: The closed event is sent by the compositor when the layer surface is closed.

request.name: set_layer

description.summary: change the layer of the surface

request.description: Change the layer that the surface is rendered on.
